issues.reason: Official Explorer description replaces "spell focus" but standard traits contain "Magick Focus" and no Spell Focus trait. The target remains deliberately unresolved, no automatic selection. Polyglot additionally modifies baseline Languages requiring component-level integration.
Detect Magic SLA class-vs-character level binding, Magical Linguist spells, once-per-day Natural-1 reroll, illusion followup saving throw, rest healing and conditional buffs need rule-engine review.
Four heritages have one-of skill choice replacing Talented; choice bonuses must not all apply or stack with old Talented selection. Lalafell age ranges are metadata awaiting Identity support.
Per-class fractional increments, some minimum class-level gates, dynamic spell catalog and capped pools require manual selection/approval.
Rule effects are mechanically paraphrased staging interpretations, not independently approved. No changes to live wizard or production manifest are authorized by structural validation.

sectionInventory.reason: All printed standard mechanics from current official page transcribed to staging.
Every printed alternate trait represented, with manual target conflicts flagged.
All printed rows; no variant heritage table is present for Half-Breed.
All 39 printed entries retained as manual class-targeted rewards.
Separate feat catalog not a racial grant.
Separate archetype catalog excluded; bloodline eligibility not auto-applied.

excludedSections.reason: Separate racial feat catalog not part of racial traits.

features.name: Ability Score Adjustment
features.description: +2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence and -2 Strength.

features.name: Type
features.description: Humanoid with tarutaru subtype.

features.name: Size
features.description: Small; usual modifiers include +1 size AC, +1 size attack, -1 CMB/CMD and +4 Stealth.

features.name: Base Speed
features.description: Land speed 20 feet.

features.name: Languages
features.description: Starts with Common and Lalafellan. High Intelligence permits Draconic, Dwarven, Elvaan, Galkan, Giant, Goblin or Orc.

features.name: Defensive Training
features.description: +4 dodge bonus AC against creatures of giant subtype.

features.name: Magic Resistant
features.description: +1 racial on saves versus spells and spell-like effects.

features.name: Stubborn
features.description: +2 racial Will against illusion spells/SLAs; if first save fails and effect persists longer than one round, another save one round later at original DC. May not stack same-round reroll abilities.

features.name: Magic Expert
features.description: +2 racial on Knowledge (arcana) and Spellcraft.

features.name: Talented
features.description: Select one Craft or Profession specialization to gain +2 racial on that skill.

features.name: Magic Aptitude
features.description: +2 racial caster-level checks to pierce spell resistance and +2 racial dispel checks.

features.name: Magick Focus
features.description: +2 racial on defensive casting concentration checks.

features.name: Spell-Like Ability
features.description: May cast detect magic as SLA at will; class level sets caster level (source wording; multiclass ambiguity unresolved).

features.name: Low-light Vision
features.description: Double normal hume visual range under poor illumination; colors and detail remain distinguishable.

features.name: Academician
features.description: Choose a single Knowledge specialty for +2 bonus; replaces Talented.

features.name: Architectural Ingenuity
features.description: +2 Knowledge (engineering), plus Craft and Perception specifically connected to structures or structural traps. Replaces Talented.

features.name: Dirty Trickster
features.description: +2 racial dirty trick maneuvers; ignore Intelligence prerequisites of Combat Expertise, Improved Dirty Trick and feats gated by Improved Dirty Trick. Replaces Defensive Training and Talented.

features.name: Eternal Hope
features.description: +2 racial saves versus fear/despair; once daily after a natural 1 on a d20, reroll and use second roll. Replaces Defensive Training.

features.name: Explorer
features.description: +2 racial Climb and a selectable Knowledge specialty. Source says replaces Talented AND "spell focus", a trait absent from standard racial list (perhaps Magick Focus); must not guess.

features.name: Inquisitive
features.description: +2 racial Disable Device and Escape Artist; replaces Magic Expert.

features.name: Intrepid Settler
features.description: +2 racial saves against fear and Acrobatics, Climb, Swim checks; replaces Magic Expert and Talented.

features.name: Magical Linguist
features.description: +1 save DC of language-dependent and glyph/symbol/magical writing spells; +2 saves against same; if CHA 11+, comprehend languages, message, read magic SLAs each once daily, caster level = character level. Replaces Spell-Like Ability.

features.name: Polyglot
features.description: +2 Linguistics, always class skill; also one extra starting language unrestricted, maintaining regular bonus languages. Replaces Magic Expert AND modifies Languages.

features.name: Practicality
features.description: +2 Craft or Profession selected specialty, Sense Motive, and saves versus illusions. Replaces Magic Expert and Magic Aptitude.

features.name: Student of the City
features.description: +2 racial Knowledge (local); may use Knowledge (local) instead of Diplomacy to gather info. Replaces Talented.

features.name: Vivacious
features.description: Healing from rest +50% (min 1), and healing spells grant extra floor(caster level / 2) HP (min 0); does not affect fast healing. Replaces Magic Resistant.

features.name: Warden of Nature
features.description: +2 dodge AC and +1 attack rolls specifically against aberrations, oozes and vermin. Replaces Defensive Training.

features.name: Wright
features.description: +2 racial Drive and vehicle-related Craft/Repair. Replaces Talented and Magic Expert.
